Type: lamp
Name: VARV
Light bulb sold separately. IKEA recommends LED bulb E27 600 lumen globe opal white. View more product information You can easily charge your smartphone wirelessly. If your phone supports wireless charging, place it on the built-in charger. If not, complete the phone with VITAHULT wireless charging cover.
